features: CONTEMPORARY DESIGN: A modern rustic style with this heartfelt 8-Opening Sentiment Dimensional Wall Collage

PREMIUM QUALITY MATERIALS: Constructed of durable high quality PS which makes it strong but lightweight; attached hardware for easy hanging; includes nine panes of premium glass that will protect and showcase your beautiful photos for years to come; attached hardware makes hanging easy

description: Add a touch of modern rustic style to any space with this heartfelt 8-Opening Sentiment Dimensional Wall Collage. It is constructed of durable high quality PS which makes it strong but lightweight. Thanks to its built in hardware this wall hanging picture frame collage will display perfectly in a wall gallery or by itself. This decorative frame features the heartfelt phrase “Cherish every memory and love every moment” screen printed on the center glass pane. Our wall hanging picture frame collage will display perfectly in a wall gallery or by itself. Simple to load with a removable back panel and swing tab closures. Includes durable glass panes that will protect and showcase your beautiful photos for years to come. Celebrate your precious memories with Malden International Designs sentiment collage frame.
